copy.tagline: 评估和改进用户交互流程
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果正在设计或审查用户操作流程
copy.tagline_en: Evaluate and improve user interaction flows
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are designing or reviewing user interaction flows

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会帮你评估或设计用户交互流程——它会逐个检查每个界面状态（加载、空、错误、成功、部分），找出边缘情况，并评价动效是否真的有用（而不是花哨装饰）。最后给出具体改进建议。
howto.when: 当你要求评估某个交互流程、检查状态覆盖、找出边缘情况或讨论动效原则时触发。

say.text: 检查这个登录按钮的微交互，包括加载和禁用状态。
say.note: Claude 会分析按钮各状态的表现。

say.text: 评估页面从空到有结果时的动效是否合适。
say.note: Claude 会对照动效原则给出评价。

say.text: 帮我找找这个表单的输入错误状态有什么遗漏。
say.note: Claude 会检查错误反馈是否清晰。

howto.what_en: After installed, Claude will help you evaluate or design user interaction flows — checking every UI state (loading, empty, error, success, partial), finding edge cases, and assessing whether animations serve the user (not just decoration). It then suggests specific improvements.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to evaluate a flow, check state coverage, find edge cases, or discuss motion principles.

say_en.text: Check the microinteractions on this login button, including loading and disabled states.
Evaluate the animation when the page goes from empty to showing results.
Find missing error states in this form input.
